## Download

**Windows:** download `RED-Spectrogram-…-windows-x64.zip` below, extract it anywhere and run `RED-Spectrogram.exe`. [sox_ng](https://codeberg.org/sox_ng/sox_ng) is included: nothing else to install.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**. You can check that the download was built by GitHub Actions from this repository with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo H4Z4RD-H42/RED-Spectrogram`, or compare it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The bundled sox_ng is licensed under the GNU GPL v2; its exact source code is attached to this release.
